title: All Unity games in the October Triple-i Initiative
summary: Discover new releases Blue Prince and Thronglets, as well as the Unity game news coming out of the Triple-i Initiative showcase.
body_markdown:
### ***Blue Prince* and Netflix Games’s *Thronglets* launch to acclaim**


Today marked the launch of two standout titles made with Unity: *Blue Prince* , an atmospheric indie puzzle adventure, and *Thronglets* , a mobile game based on an episode of the latest *Black Mirror* season.


The best-reviewed game of 2025 so far,[Blue Prince](https://www.blueprincegame.com/) launched today on Steam, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. After eight years in development the first release from Dogubomb studio is already being heralded as a game of the year contender with its genre-blending mechanics set in a mysterious, ever-shifting mansion.


Also announced today, from Netflix Games and the critically acclaimed studio Night School comes[Thronglets](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/black-mirror-thronglets/id6529524046) , a mobile game that immerses fans in the world of *Black Mirror* like never before. *Thronglets* , the game at the center of the Season 7 episode “Plaything,” is out now and available exclusively for Netflix members.
